title: ColaPri: a Starvation-Free, Class-Oriented Load-Adaptive Priority Scheduler for Cloud Task Scheduling (reproduction package)
description: Reproduction package for the ColaPri paper: a weighted-fair cloud task scheduler with per-class weights, a provable per-task bounded-waiting (no-starvation) guarantee with counter resynchronisation after idle periods and load-adaptive activation, implemented as a CloudletScheduler for CloudSim Plus 8.5.7. Includes the scheduler, eight baseline schedulers (FCFS, SJF, strict priority, priority+aging, an equal-share-per-class queue, CloudSim Plus's time-shared processor-sharing scheduler, DFPO, and start-time fair queueing with ColaPri's own weights as the classical weighted-fair control), four task-to-VM mapping policies, all seven experiment harnesses (EXP-A..G, including a sweep of the aging factor of the priority-with-aging baseline), a correction for a dispatch-order defect of CloudSim Plus 8.5.7 that let arriving cloudlets bypass the waiting queue of any space-shared scheduler (CloudletSchedulerFifo, with the EngineProbe that measures it), a per-task audit of the paper's waiting bound, the captured result logs behind every table in the paper, figure-generation scripts, the bundled PlanetLab, Bitbrains and Materna trace subsets, and SHA-256 checksums plus provenance for the third-party traces that cannot be redistributed (Alibaba, Azure). All simulated metrics are seed-deterministic and reproduce bit-identically. This work has been granted by the Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades (MICIU) AEI/10.13039/501100011033 under contract PID2023-146193OB-I00.
